newsitem.title: HONDURAS: Looters rob sunken galleons off Honduras.
newsitem.headline: Looters rob sunken galleons off Honduras.

text.p: Looters are robbing treasure from Spanish galleons that sank off the coast of Honduras centuries ago, Honduran Culture Minister Rodolfo Pastor said on Sunday.

"We've seen the treasures of these galleons looted because we don't have the capacity to install navy watches in the 20 or 25 places were galleons exist," he told reporters. "They have been looted for several years and they will continue to be looted because don't have the patrol boats to prevent this from happening."
The galleons, shipwrecked off Honduras' Atlantic Coast in the 1500s, were carrying treasure back to Spain, Pastor said. He estimated they contain about $3 billion worth.

If the government could retrieve the treasure "it would be a great relief for the economic situation" of Honduras, a poor Central American country currently being rocked by a series of strikes and protests, he said.
He proposed legislative reforms that would allow the government to work with international institutions capable of raising the galleons from the ocean floor.
